{{Quote|We feast! Prepare the food, your masters are hungry.|The soldier talking to the kidnapped Ming Po|<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>}}
A '''Mandalorian''' was part of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] terrorist organization and was stationed in a [[Death Watch camp|camp]] on the snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
After junior senator [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] arrived on the planet of Carlac along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to deliver a [[Holotrace device/Legends|holotrace device]] with the location of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to the Mandalorian terrorist organization known as the Death Watch, the three were lead by the Mandalorians into their campsite.

This soldier was later seen in the evening, going inside the tent where the captive [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] females were held and ordering them to prepare the food. The next morning, the Death Watch members, including this soldier, attacked the [[Ming Po town]], forcing Ahsoka Tano to reveal her true identity and was eventually captured by the Mandalorians. Facing execution, Ahsoka was saved by R2-D2, who sent the repaired [[Monster droid/Legends|junk droids]] to fight the Death Watch and allowed Lux and Ahsoka enough time to escape.
